title: SMS Delivery Delays in US East
customerImpact: Up to 3 minutes of additional delivery time for SMS sent to US East destinations. No messages lost.

updates.author: Ruth Chen, SRE
updates.details: We are investigating an increase in SMS delivery latency for US East destinations. Inbound API traffic is unaffected.

updates.author: Ruth Chen, SRE
updates.details: The delay originates from a carrier-side routing change announced by one of our US providers. We have failed over a portion of US East traffic to the secondary provider and are monitoring delivery times.
updates.customerImpact: Latency has been reduced from 3 minutes to under 60 seconds for failed-over traffic.
